app.name: IbexGit
repos.title: All Repositories
repos.empty: No repositories yet — open a local folder to get started
repos.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete group "{name}"? Its repositories move to Ungrouped; the repositories themselves are not deleted.
welcome.title: Welcome to IbexGit
welcome.subtitle: Local-first Git graphical client
welcome.dragHint: Tip: you can also drop a folder (or any file inside a repo) into this window
welcome.newSoon: Repository creation will arrive in P7
sidebar.checkoutMsg: Checkout branch "{name}"? Uncommitted changes may block or carry over.
statusbar.tasksEmptyHint: Long tasks (fetch, push, rebase…) will appear here
workspace.discardConfirmDesc: Discard changes in {n} file(s). A recovery snapshot is created first.
workspace.discardUntrackedWarn: Untracked files will be deleted; they can be restored from the recovery list (except oversized ones).
workspace.ignoreConfirmDesc: The following paths will be appended to .gitignore:
workspace.subCommit: Submodule HEAD differs from the recorded commit
workspace.skipWorktree: skip-worktree: worktree changes of this file are ignored
workspace.diffHint: Click a file on the left to view its diff
diff.binaryHint: Binary files are not shown as text diff
diff.truncated: Diff too large, showing first {lines} lines (virtual scrolling and syntax highlighting arrive in P4)
commit.subject: Commit Subject
commit.pushSoon: Push arrives in P6/P7; only a local commit was made
conflict.entered: Conflict occurred — the resolution flow is active
conflict.deleteConfirmDesc: Removes {path} from the worktree and index to resolve the conflict.
conflict.binaryHint: Binary conflicts cannot be edited here — keep one side or use an external tool.
conflict.oversized: File exceeds the editing limit (2MB) — keep one side or use an external merge tool.
conflict.notEditable: This conflict cannot be edited in-app — keep one side or use an external tool.
conflict.directoryHint: File/directory conflict: a directory occupies the path. Only delete/choose actions are offered (full file-side mapping UI comes later).
conflict.submoduleHint: Submodule pointer conflict — please resolve it in a terminal.
conflict.mergetoolFailed: The external tool did not resolve the conflict — retry or resolve manually
conflict.commitHint.merge: Finishing the merge: resolved files are staged already; commit to conclude.
conflict.commitHint.cherry_pick: Finishing the cherry-pick: resolved files are staged already; commit to continue.
conflict.commitHint.revert: Finishing the revert: resolved files are staged already; commit to conclude.
conflict.op.abortConfirmDesc: All in-progress merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert changes will be discarded and the repository returns to its pre-operation state.
recovery.title: Recovery snapshots
recovery.description: Automatic snapshots taken before discards — restore the exact worktree and index state with one click.
recovery.emptyHint: Snapshots are created automatically before discards
dialog.checkout.title: Checkout Branch
dialog.about.title: About IbexGit
dialog.about.desc: {name} v{version} — local-first Git graphical client. Progress: P2 app skeleton.
dialog.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
history.emptyHint: No commits match the current filters
history.selectCommit: Select a commit to inspect its changes
history.selectFile: Select a changed file to view its diff
history.restoreFile: Restore this version to the worktree
history.restoreConfirmDesc: Overwrite the worktree version of {path} with the version from this commit? The current worktree content is snapshotted and can be restored.
history.cherryPickTitle: Cherry-pick {n} commits onto the current branch?
history.opPreviewDesc: Review the commits before executing. New commits will appear on the current branch.
history.squashDesc: The selected newest consecutive commits collapse into a single commit. Edit the combined message below.
history.squashWarn: Squashing rewrites the recent history (recoverable via the reflog).
history.squashNotEligible: Squash requires the newest consecutive commits from HEAD (no merges)
history.detachedBanner: HEAD is detached — commits you make here are not on any branch.
history.createBranchDesc: Name a new branch that points at the current HEAD and check it out.
fileView.blameHint: Line-by-line attribution of the worktree file
fileView.selectCommit: Select a commit to preview its diff of this file
blame.jumpHint: Click a line to view its commit's diff
refs.panel.title: References
refs.newBranch.title: New Branch
refs.upstream.title: Track upstream for {name}
refs.upstream.label: Upstream (e.g. origin/main)
refs.deleteBranch.title: Delete branch {name}
refs.deleteBranch.forceDesc: This branch has commits that are not merged into any other branch. Force delete?
refs.deleteBranch.forceWarn: The commits only reachable from this branch may become unreachable (GC after the reflog expires).
refs.reset.title: Reset current branch
refs.reset.desc: Move the branch pointer to another commit. Recovery anchors are created automatically.
refs.reset.descSoft: Move branch only — index and working tree stay untouched
refs.reset.descMixed: Move branch and reset the index — working tree files are kept
refs.reset.descHard: Move branch, reset index AND discard all working tree changes
refs.reset.targetPlaceholder: Target: commit hash, branch, tag, HEAD~1…
refs.reset.hardWarn: A recovery snapshot (unstaged/staged changes) and a backup ref at the current HEAD are created first — the reset is one-click undoable.
refs.reset.undoHint: A backup ref was created at the previous HEAD
refs.clean.title: Clean untracked files
refs.clean.desc: Review the removable untracked files and confirm each one. Nothing is deleted without confirmation.
refs.clean.empty: Nothing to clean — no untracked files
refs.clean.warn: Deletion is undoable via the recovery snapshot.
refs.backups.title: Backup refs (recovery points)
refs.backups.desc: Track-B recovery points under refs/ibexgit/backups/. They keep rewritten commits reachable until deleted.
refs.backups.gcHint: Deleting a backup ref lets git garbage-collect those commits again.
refs.tagDialog.title: Create tag
refs.tagDialog.desc: Leave the message empty for a lightweight tag; with a message an annotated tag is created.
refs.deleteTag.title: Delete tag {name}
refs.deleteTag.desc: The tag is removed locally. Pushed tags must be deleted on the remote separately.
refs.tags.emptyHint: Create annotated or lightweight tags from the toolbar or the commit detail panel
refs.remote.desc: The fetch URL is used for fetch/pull; the push URL can be adjusted from .gitconfig when needed.
refs.remote.name: Name
refs.remote.removeDesc: The remote and its tracking configuration are removed; local branches stay untouched.
refs.merge.title: Merge into current branch
refs.merge.desc: Merge the selected branch into {branch}. The preview lists the incoming commits.
refs.merge.nothing: Nothing to merge — already up to date
refs.merge.ffOnly: Only fast-forward (refuse to create a merge commit)
refs.rebase.title: Rebase onto target
refs.rebase.desc: Replay the commits of {branch} onto the selected branch. The preview lists the replayed commits.
refs.rebase.warn: Rebasing rewrites history — the current branch's commits get new hashes (recoverable via reflog).
refs.pull.title: Pull
refs.pull.modeMergeDesc: Fetch then merge the remote branch (default)
refs.pull.modeRebaseDesc: Fetch then rebase local commits on top
refs.push.title: Push
refs.push.forceWarn: Force-with-lease overwrites the remote branch if nobody else pushed in the meantime. Commits on the remote that you do not have locally can still be lost. Type the branch name to confirm.
refs.push.forceMismatch: Type exactly "{branch}" to enable the force button
refs.compare.title: Compare refs
refs.compare.desc: Pick two refs to see ahead/behind, both commit lists and the file diff between them.
refs.compare.mergeBaseHint: ↑n = commits ahead of the other side
refs.compare.pickFile: Select a file to view its diff
refs.compare.pickTwo: Pick two different refs to compare
refs.stash.dropDesc: The entry is removed from the stash list. Its commit stays in the reflog for a while.
refs.stashDiff.title: Stash diff
refs.reflog.title: Reflog (HEAD)
refs.reflog.restoreDesc: Hard-reset the current branch to {hash}? Working tree changes are snapshotted first; the move is undoable.
commit.pushNoRemote: No remote configured — only a local commit was made
net.cloneDesc: Clone via HTTPS or SSH; credentials are handled in-app.
net.cloneProgressHint: You can cancel at any time; the partial folder will be cleaned up.
net.initDesc: Create an empty repository (default branch: main).
net.managerDesc: Credentials live in the OS keychain; nothing is stored in plain text.
net.credEmpty: No saved credentials yet. They are remembered when you check “Remember” during sign-in.
net.hostEmpty: No trusted hosts yet. New hosts are confirmed by fingerprint on first connection.
net.proxyNoneHint: Clear proxy environment variables for git
cred.askpassDesc: The remote is asking for input.
cred.rememberHint: Credentials are stored in the OS keychain only after the server accepts them.
cred.hostkeyDesc: First connection to this host: verify the fingerprint before trusting.
